comment: Each key is two parameters: an even-indexed one carrying the key itself and an odd-indexed one for MIDI mapping (src/virtualgrid/VirtualGridModule.cpp:90-108). Only the even-indexed parameters are given a widget (src/virtualgrid/VirtualGridWidget.cpp:97), so only those can be clicked; the odd ones get no line and no tag. The maker's parameter names are wrong throughout: the naming loop computes its index as i + j * w * 2 while the widget uses (i + j * w) * 2, so the tooltip on key (1,0) reads (2,0) and most of the names are either doubled or blank. One line covers every key because they are identical. The module has no inputs and no outputs.
